paper.title: Order-by-disorder and emergent Kosterlitz-Thouless phase in a triangular Rydberg array

observable.description: <|m|> — modulus of the per-shot three-sublattice order parameter m = (3/N) sum_j (n_j - nbar) exp(i K.r_j), averaged over shots

_notes: R_b/a sets the phase, not a paper value copied across: at Omega = 2*pi*2 MHz and the FRESNEL_CAN1-class C6, R_b = 6.4 um, so a = 5.3 um gives R_b/a = 1.21 — an atom blockades its six nearest neighbours but not the next-nearest, which is what selects the sqrt3 x sqrt3 three-sublattice order. Guo et al. quote R_b ~ 1.2a. a = 5.3 um also clears the 5 um minimum trap spacing. tau_ns stops at 5800 because the two 100 ns amplitude edges plus tau must fit the 6000 ns maximum sequence duration. N = 49 (L = 7) is the FRESNEL_CAN1-class variant; L = 10 (N = 100) reaches ~41 um and needs SA1 — see README.md. The register was sized against Pulser's bundled AnalogDevice as a stand-in, not against live device specs, so validate-emu will reject it if the live device is tighter.
